summary_en: This study tests adding low-dose radiation to the liver in people with melanoma or non-small cell lung cancer that has spread to the liver and who are receiving immunotherapy. The liver radiation is given the week before cycles 1, 2 and 3 of standard immunotherapy. The study measures progression-free survival (PFS), which is the main outcome.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa agregar radiación de dosis baja al hígado en personas con melanoma o cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas que se ha extendido al hígado y que reciben inmunoterapia. La radiación al hígado se administra la semana antes de los ciclos 1, 2 y 3 de la inmunoterapia estándar. El estudio mide la supervivencia libre de progresión (PFS), que es el resultado principal.
who_for: ECOG performance status 2 or lower, or Karnofsky 60% or higher.
Biopsy-proven non-small cell lung cancer or melanoma.
Planning to receive PD-1 or PD-L1 checkpoint immunotherapy throughout the radiation treatment.
not_for: Adjuvant immunotherapy for NSCLC or melanoma delivered within 6 months of enrollment.
NSCLC with EGFR, ALK, ROS1 or RET driver mutations (for cohort 1).
Uncontrolled illness that the investigator judges makes participation unreasonably hazardous.
Prior or concurrent malignancy that the investigator judges could interfere with safety or efficacy assessment.
